description: Normalize alphanumeric/apostrophe words; compare hashed seven-word windows; independently flag matching quote pairs with >=4 words. Retrieval sums twice index term occurrences plus distinct lexical hits, ranks (-score,index), takes30, expands +/-1, returns up to90 ascending indices. Invalid index positions are skipped before scoring. Teacher/rewrite/log path is read-only effect modeling, not executed correspondence.
state: Supplied worlds/frames or book strings, token sets and optional local index; external dependencies opaque.
cost: B normalized book bytes and A normalized answer bytes: expected fixed-width-window hash construction O(B), membership scans O(A), plus emitted bytes. Retrieval reads index/sentence bytes, builds ordered sets/maps and sorts K scored indices O(K log K).
